why: Both analyses land on the home-state retail and small-business hedgehog, the same core stop-doing items and all four key brutal facts, so they are hard to separate on substance. Analysis 2 edges ahead by putting 'lowest-cost' into the hedgehog and cost-to-serve as the weakest link, naming Stage 3 denial as the current danger, and answering the board's succession question in the one-screen verdict with an explicit warning against a change-agent CEO hired to enter new businesses.
